verdict.rationale: Stripe Tax documents product tax codes (PTCs) that associate products with tax rates, with a preset default for products that have no PTC set. Rates are determined by product type and location across a documented list of supported locations, and results come back with a taxability_reason and line-item breakdowns. missing for 10: explicit evidence of the specific category taxonomy (SaaS, digital goods, services, physical goods), documentation of per-line-item PTC assignment in the API, and independent hands-on corroboration of per-jurisdiction taxability accuracy.

support.subject: As a developer, I can map my catalog to the vendor's tax categories — SaaS, digital goods, services, physical products — so each line item is taxed by what it is, in every jurisdiction it sells
